ns2:section.sectionText: The philosophy of the class is experiential learning. Students will be instructed in the fundamental of professional film production including casting, rehearsal with theater students, blocking, staging, scheduling film shooting, and other aspects of the workflow of fiction filmmaking. There will be a division of labor: each one of the students will be assigned a key crew position. These positions are assigned by the instructor based on a student's previous performance in MACS production courses (particularly MACS 370). These key crew positions are: Assistant director, location manager, Casting director, Art director and assistants for Make-up, Props and Wardrobe, Director of Photography (DOP), Focus puller, Clapper loader, Gaffer, Key grip, Sound man, DIT and editor. The semester will culminate in a public screening of the class short movie.
